description: This chart illustrates the distribution of task types related to article generation. The pie chart contains four slices representing different categories: “Article generation” in red, accounting for 83.1%; “Headline generation” in yellow, representing 12.8%; “Article editing” in blue, at 4.1%; and a central section labeled “Task Type” in black. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The chart does not include a separate legend, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like explosion or bolding. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice, “Article generation”, positioned first.
